question: What is the official definition of 30-day venue churn?
statement: A venue is counted as churned when it processed at least one paid order in the previous 30 complete calendar days and processed zero paid orders in the last 30 complete calendar days. The metric is a venue count, not a GMV amount.

citations.title: Venue GMV
citations.quote: Venue GMV is the sum of `order_gross_amount` for paid orders, including VAT, excluding tips, refunds, and failed payments. Currency is the venue settlement currency; GCC reporting converts to AED using the Finance daily rate at order time, not at payout time.
